description: Salted commitment fixture: commitment = SHA-256(salt_bytes || UTF-8(value)). Demonstrates the hiding commitment used for pseudonymised subjects/fields.

expected.note: commit(salt, value) = 'sha256:' + hex(SHA256(base64url_decode(salt) || utf8(value))). Verifier recomputes with the disclosed (salt, value) and compares. Brute-force resistance rests ENTIRELY on salt entropy + value unpredictability — a low-entropy value (e.g. a known email) is dictionary-attackable regardless of salt.
